note: Fields a functional point depends on, reconciled across three sources: the spec/contract (what must be observable), the Scala (who writes it), and the generated DUT port surface (what can actually be driven/sampled). 'expect=port' means the field must exist in dut/<dut>/signals.json. 'expect=absent' records a field the Scala needs but the generated port does not carry; it must state a reason and re-opens the adjudication if the port ever appears. Checked by suites/memblock/lsq/tools/audit_scala_rtl_fields.py --strict and modules/lsq_wrapper/tests/meta/test_critical_fields.py.

fields.reason: THE DEFECT, surfaced mechanically by this diff: DeqModule reads resp.bits.denied (NewStoreQueue.scala:1095) but no such port exists because the producer never drives it (Uncache.scala:118-128 leaves denied/corrupt at DontCare). The two bits the RTL reads are exactly the two shapes this tool reports as scala-only. The fix must expose nderr/error instead of resurrecting denied/corrupt.
fields.reopen_if: the port appears, or the Scala switches to nderr/error
